examples: Open a new computer in the Pack and run a first prompt that already has your CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills and mods.
Press sync now after editing a hook on the main computer.
Turn on automatic sync so the Pack follows the main computer's setup.
how_to: Open pack, logins, my global setup (on the main computer only) and turn on sync my global setup.
Say yes to copy there for each computer in the list; the other computer must also allow receiving global setup (the join code turns that on).
Pick claude code, codex or both, then press sync now, or turn on keep it synced automatically.
Nothing private travels: conversations, history, logs, caches, databases and logins stay put, secrets in env values are scrubbed, and the receiver keeps a backup of anything it overwrites.
media_exempt: Needs a paired computer that passed the approval gate, which a leased test slot does not have; no capture is defined yet.
name: Pack global setup sync
summary: the main computer copies your global claude code and codex setup to the approved computers in the Pack, so a new computer behaves like this one from the first prompt.
where: Pack, logins tab: the my global setup block (main computer) and the may receive global setup switch (this computer); the mcp tools pack_global_sync status and sync now.
